explanation: Solid-core gas-shielded MIG runs DCEP: ground clamp into the Negative (−) socket and the wire-feed power cable into the Positive (+) socket. (p. 14)

Flux-cored (gasless) MIG runs DCEN: ground clamp into the Positive (+) socket and the wire-feed power cable into the Negative (−) socket. The flux core shields the weld, so the polarity is reversed from gas-shielded MIG. (p. 13)
TIG runs DCEN: ground clamp into the Positive (+) socket and the TIG torch cable into the Negative (−) socket. (p. 24)

Stick (SMAW) on this welder is set up DCEP per the manual: ground clamp into the Negative (−) socket and the electrode holder cable into the Positive (+) socket. Some specialty rods call for DCEN — always follow the electrode manufacturer's instructions. (p. 27)
